deliverables: Essential Oura codebase maintenance including dependency updates, Cardano protocol compatibility, performance improvements, bug fixing, and documentation.
Community support including issue triage, review of external contributions, ecosystem-feedback-driven enhancements, and public developer communication.
AI-friendly documentation and integration resources for AI-driven development workflows.
Use of Intersect treasury management smart contracts, reporting obligations, and milestone-based disbursement controls.
request.recipient: TxPipe via Intersect treasury withdrawal process
request.what: Funding for Oura by TxPipe maintenance over 12 months, including part-time maintainer work, Intersect administration, and contingency reserve.

claims.claim: The proposal requests 420,000 ADA plus a 105,000 ADA contingency reserve for a part-time Oura maintainer over 12 months at an annual rate of $105,000 USD.
The on-chain treasury withdrawal amount is 540,750 ADA, consisting of 525,000 ADA for Oura maintenance and enhancement plus a 15,750 ADA Intersect Budget Administration fee.
Oura is a Rust-native pipeline tool that connects to Cardano nodes, monitors blockchain events, and routes matching patterns to pluggable outputs.
Oura supports multiple data sources and many output sinks including Kafka, Elasticsearch, AWS services, RabbitMQ, Redis, SQL databases, and webhooks.
Oura has 654 commits, 288 stars, 79 forks, and 58 contributors, and is the most starred project in the TxPipe portfolio.
Oura has previously been funded twice through Project Catalyst, in Fund 9 and Fund 13, for feature development.
TxPipe has received funding through 30 Project Catalyst proposals from Funds 9 through 14, with 26 successfully delivered and 4 currently under development and on schedule.
The proposal achieved the required 67% support threshold during the 2026 Intersect Budget Process Hydra Voting phase.
The requested amount does not, at submission, breach the applicable 350M Net Change Limit covering Epoch 613 to Epoch 713.
Intersect will provide administration, third-party oversight, reporting obligations, milestone-based disbursement controls, and smart-contract-based treasury management for the withdrawn funds.

summary: The anchor requests 540,750 ADA for 12 months of Oura maintenance by TxPipe through Intersect, with stated maintenance, support, AI-documentation, oversight, and smart-contract fund-management arrangements, but the deterministic assessment records missing budget, feasibility, risk, alternatives, and failure-mode analysis.
